context_for_next_testing_agent: ITER7 BUGS FIXED & VERIFIED: (1) score-based detect_language() correctly classifies en/es/fr/de/it/pt/pl/ar/hi/zh/ur — no more ` la ` overlap. (2) chat send-btn now dispatches and renders msg-user-0, msg-lex-1, ts-0, ts-1 (timestamps localized to user locale). Open items carried over from iter6/iter7 (server.py size > 700 lines, free-tier TTS quota, Haiku→Sonnet fallback unit test, tagline i18n) are non-blocking. Login flow requires THREE modals to be dismissed first: (a) language picker (OK button), (b) T&C (checkbox + Accept & Continue), then (c) login form with data-testid='auth-submit-btn' (NOT 'login-btn'). Use force=True clicks on tiny mobile viewports.
rca of the issue: Iter7 RCAs fully addressed in this iteration. BUG 1 (French→Spanish mis-detection): replaced ordered if/elif Latin-script heuristic with a score-based detector using word-boundary regex per language; ` la ` no longer dominates because each language now contributes a count and the max wins (Spanish needs ¿/¡/usted/hola/qué etc., French needs bonjour/voudrais/savoir/c'est/quels etc.). Verified by 11 distinct language pytest cases (es,fr,de,it,pt,pl,ar,hi,zh + spanish-la-overlap + french-la-overlap) — all PASS. BUG 2 (chat send produced no bubbles + no ts-*): root cause was the Emergent preview badge overlay z-index intercepting send-btn clicks at the bottom of the modal on 390px viewports. Fix combined padding-bottom:56px on the chat input row + modal-bg z-index bumped to 9999 / modal-card to 10000 in /app/frontend/src/index.css. Verified live: clicking send-btn (force=False also works after fix) now produces user bubble + AI reply + two ts-* timestamp elements, all with correct testids.
